root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `usb_anchor_urb(urb, &dev->rx_submitted)` before resubmission and unanchors only on failure, directly fixing the missing re-anchor. The commit message explicitly states: "the USB framework unanchors the URB before the complete function is called... it is no longer anchored and is ultimately not released in usb_kill_anchored_urbs()."
